title: Contracts Manager
description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
------------------------------------

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

  

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.

  

The Global Business Center \- Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

  

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community\-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

  

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What role you will play in team**
-----------------------------------

  

The Contracts Manager will be responsible for managing the full contract lifecycle, optimizing Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and ensuring strong supplier and stakeholder alignment across categories. This role provides, commercial oversight, governance cadence management, and operational rigor, ensuring that contracting outcomes consistently deliver value, mitigate risk, and support category and business strategies. Work closely with, internal stakeholders, Legal, and Supply partners to drive performance, streamline contracting processes, and ensure high\-quality execution across pre award, award, and post award contract lifecycle stages.

  

Job will be based at Bangalore, Whitefield office ( WFO) for 5 days in a week.

**What you will do**
--------------------

  



**Key Responsibilities**

  

1\. **Commercial Delivery \& Quality Assurance**

* Oversee and review all major negotiations to ensure commercial excellence.
* Validate pricing structures, terms \& conditions, performance metrics, service levels, and risk allocation.
* Ensure agreements fully reflect business needs, category guidance, and global procurement standards.
* Support development of negotiation strategies, bid evaluations, and award recommendations.

 **2\. Contract Lifecycle Ownership \& Governance**

* Ensure full contract lifecycle in alignment with corporate procedures (Requisition\-to\-Pay, MOC, stewardship).
* Maintain governance over scopes, pricing updates, exhibits, amendments, and supplier performance mechanisms.
* Oversee contract compliance and ensure supplier performance monitoring, issue resolution, and utilization tracking.
* Support standardization and efficiency of contracting processes, tools, and templates.

 **3\. Category Strategy \& Business Alignment**

* Partner with Category Managers to translate category strategy into contracting plans and execution roadmaps.
* Align team activities with Category commercial and strategic guidance, market intelligence, and risk outlook.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate demand, optimize contracting models, and enhance value across categories.
* Provide commercial insights to drive cost avoidance, cost mitigation, and lifecycle value.

 **4\. Supplier Relationship \& Performance Oversight**

* Ensure strong supplier engagement and drives value in negotiations and performance management.
* Provide escalation support for supplier issues, performance gaps, stewardship, or commercial disputes.
* Ensure actively track performance trends and utilize insights to inform contract changes or renewals.

 **5\. Risk Management \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to corporate policies, legal requirements, and internal controls across all agreements.
* Partner with Legal and Risk to ensure contract language, liability frameworks, and operational requirements are aligned with corporate standards.
* Mitigate supply and legal risk through rigorous review of commercial terms and supplier commitments.

 **6\. Operational Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the improvement of contracting processes, templates, guidelines, and tools.
* Drive consistency reduce cycle time and increase contracting quality.
* Support implementation of digital tools, sourcing platforms, and data\-driven insights for better decision\-making.
**About you**
-------------

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or relevant experience stream with minimum 6 CGPA
* Minimum 3 years of experience in contracting, negotiations, vendor management, procurement, sourcing, or supply chain operations.
* Strong knowledge of TCO analysis, sourcing levers, commercial models, and contract law fundamentals.
* Demonstrated ability to influence, collaborate cross\-functionally, and manage multiple categories or portfolios.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience of Contracting one/multiple categories from below list:  

	+ HR/workforce enablement
	+ MSP
	+ Engineering services
	+ Contingent labor
	+ business support
* Experience in Oil \& Gas, Energy, Manufacturing, or other large\-scale industrial procurement environments.
* Experience with competitive bids, auctions, complex negotiations, and multi\-region contracting.
* Knowledge of procurement systems (ERP, sourcing tools), RtP processes, and contract lifecycle management platforms.
* Understanding of market trends, supplier landscapes, and category strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver continuous improvement across procurement processes
* Proven track record of managing vendor relationships, negotiating contracts, and driving cost efficiencies.
* Minimum Annual spend managed minimum $ 1M.

 **Preferred Qualifications/ Experience**

**Key Competencies**

* Commercial Acumen \& Negotiation
* Strategic Thinking \& Category Alignment
* Governance \& Compliance
* Analytical Problem\-Solving
* Stakeholder Influence
* Communication \& Executive Presence
* Process Improvement \& Standardization
**Your benefits**

* Design, deploy, and continuously improve enterprise DLP solutions across endpoints, email, cloud environments, and enterprise SaaS applications. Own tooling, policy tuning, incident response workflows, and effectiveness reporting to senior leadership

* Own the DSPM program to continuously discover, classify, and monitor sensitive data across cloud environments and AI and SaaS applications. Drive remediation of misconfigurations, shadow data, unprotected storage, and over\-privileged access
* Integrate DSPM insights with broader security operations to maintain a unified data risk posture, and define data access policies in partnership with IAM/IGA teams to enforce least\-privilege principles
* Provide cloud security architecture guidance across multi\-cloud environments (AWS,Azure, GCP) covering IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS; conduct security assessments of externally consumed SaaS applications, AI applications and internally deployed workloads to evaluate architectural risks and data security control gaps
* Define and drive the enterprise AI Security and Governance strategy, establishing policies, risk frameworks, and controls for the secure and responsible adoption of AIte chnologies and platforms including generative AI, LLM\-based applications, and third\-party AI based SaaS services.

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with


cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.

* Review (initially and annually thereafter), understand, and adhere to Information Security/Privacy Policies and Procedures such as (but not limited to):

  

\> Data Classification, Retention \& Handling Policy
\> Incident Response Policy/Procedures
\> Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Policy/Procedures
\> Mobile Device Policy
\> Account Management Policy
\> Access Control Policy
\> Personnel Security Policy
\> Privacy Policy

You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us! ***Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team. title: Doctor
description:
At **DGVS**, we believe that quality healthcare is a fundamental right, not a privilege. Our mission is to bridge the gap between medical resources and underserved communities. Through our **Mobile Medical Van Initiative**, we take the hospital directly to the doorsteps of those who need it most—bringing healing, comfort, and free medication to diverse locations every single day.

We are seeking a compassionate, resilient, and dedicated medical professional to lead our mobile clinic and make a tangible difference on the front lines of community health.

**Position Overview**

As a **Mobile Medical Van Doctor**, you will be the face of DGVS’s healthcare outreach. This is not a typical desk job. Every day, you will travel to different communities, setup a mobile clinic, diagnose patients who often have limited access to healthcare, and provide them with essential treatments and medications.

If you are driven by purpose, thrive in dynamic environments, and want to use your medical skills for pure humanitarian impact, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Mobile Patient Care:** Conduct daily OPD consultations inside and alongside the mobile van at various designated locations.
* **Diagnosis \& Treatment:** Diagnose and treat acute and chronic illnesses across diverse age groups (pediatric to geriatric).
* **Medication Distribution:** Screen, prescribe, and oversee the dispensing of free medicines from the van’s inventory.
* **Community Health Education:** Guidance on hygiene, nutrition, and preventive healthcare to empower local communities.
* **Emergency Response:** Provide primary stabilization and refer severe cases to nearby secondary or tertiary hospitals when necessary.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with the van driver, support staff, and local community volunteers to ensure smooth operations.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Qualifications:** Valid MBBS degree with a current registration with the Medical Council.
* **Experience:** Prior experience in general practice, emergency medicine, or community health is preferred, but passionate freshers dedicated to charity work are welcome.
* **Skills:** Strong diagnostic skills with limited resources, adaptability, and excellent communication.
* **Heart for Service:** Deep empathy, patience, and a non\-judgmental attitude toward vulnerable or marginalized populations.
* **Language:** Fluency in the local language(s) of the region is highly desirable to connect effectively with patients.

**Job Perks \& Work Environment**

* **Impact:** The unmatched satisfaction of serving those who genuinely need your help.
* **Dynamic Setting:** No two days are the same; you will experience the rich diversity of different communities daily.
* **Schedule:** Day shifts only (No night shifts or on\-call emergencies).
* **Support:** You will be accompanied by a dedicated team (driver/coordinator and a pharmacist/nurse) to assist you with logistics and medicine dispensing.
* **Compensation:** A competitive honorarium/salary aligned with NGO standards, along with travel provisions.

"The best way to find yourself is to lose yourself in the service of others."If your passion for medicine goes beyond the walls of a traditional hospital, join DGVS in driving change—one village, one slum, and one patient at a time.

title: Sytem Administrator
description:
About Us

Windowmaker Software Limited is a highly esteemed software company in the window and door industry. With over 40 years of experience, we have built a reputation for crafting innovative, industry\-leading solutions trusted by customers worldwide. We are scaling our cloud platform and the internal systems that run the business, and this role is central to keeping both fast, secure, and reliable.

Why This Role Exists

We are upgrading this position from a traditional system administrator to a Systems \& Cloud Engineer. The difference is ownership and leverage. We do not want someone who only reacts to tickets. We want an engineer who runs our internal IT and cloud environment (identity, endpoints, Microsoft 365, security operations, and the Azure resources that support the business) as a product: automating the repetitive work, hardening security by default, and using modern AI\-assisted tooling to do more with a small team.

Key ResponsibilitiesCloud and Infrastructure

* **Operate and right\-size** Microsoft Azure resources used by the business, including cost governance, monitoring, tagging, and acting on Azure Advisor and security recommendations.
* **Maintain on\-premises and cloud** server, storage, networking, and telecommunication systems, planning upgrades and replacements before they become emergencies.
* **Maintain** a healthy, documented baseline for system performance and capacity, and report on it proactively.

Identity, Security and Compliance

* **Administer** Microsoft Entra ID (identity, conditional access, MFA, and least\-privilege access) and the full joiner\-mover\-leaver lifecycle.
* **Manage** endpoint and email security using the Microsoft Defender suite and triage alerts in Microsoft Sentinel or the equivalent SIEM.
* **Implement and maintain** IT security controls, data governance (for example Microsoft Purview), and compliance initiatives, and support audits and certifications.
* **Champion** a security\-first posture: patching discipline, vulnerability remediation, and incident response for IT systems.

Endpoint and End\-User Support

* **Manage** device provisioning, configuration, and compliance through Microsoft Intune, moving the fleet toward zero\-touch deployment.
* **Provide** responsive support to end users for hardware, software, and access issues, with clear SLAs and root\-cause follow\-up rather than repeat firefighting.
* **Handle** software and hardware installations, upgrades, and replacements across the business.

Automation and AI\-Enabled Operations

* **Automate** recurring IT work using scripting (PowerShell strongly preferred) and platform automation, so manual effort drops over time.
* **Adopt and govern** AI\-assisted tooling into daily operations, for example Microsoft Copilot for administration, AI\-driven monitoring and anomaly detection, and AI\-assisted ticket deflection and knowledge\-base responses.
* **Help define** clear, safe internal guidelines for AI tool usage across the company, including data\-handling boundaries, so colleagues use these tools productively and securely.
* **Contribute to** the IT roadmap and surface practical opportunities where automation or AI measurably reduces cost, risk, or response time.

Reliability, Backup and Business Continuity

* **Own and verify** backup, recovery, and business continuity processes, and test restores on a regular schedule rather than assuming they work.
* **Run** system monitoring and alerting so issues are caught and resolved before users report them.
* **Be** available outside normal business hours for critical incidents, major outages, urgent business needs, or security events.

Documentation and Continuous Improvement

* **Maintain** accurate IT documentation, runbooks, policies, and operational procedures, kept current as the environment changes.
* **Support** IT governance and bring industry best practices into how the team works.
* **Participate** in special projects and cross\-functional initiatives as assigned.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 to 8 years in IT systems, infrastructure, or cloud operations, with clear evidence of growing ownership over that time.
* Hands\-on experience administering Microsoft Windows Server, Microsoft Entra ID (Active Directory), Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Azure.
* Working knowledge of cloud security, governance, backup, and disaster recovery, with practical not just theoretical exposure.
* Scripting and automation ability, ideally PowerShell.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, and clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, and a genuine desire to keep learning.

Preferred (Strengthens an Application)

* Relevant Microsoft certifications such as AZ\-104 (Azure Administrator), MS\-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator), MD\-102 (Endpoint Administrator), SC\-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), or SC\-200 (Security Operations Analyst).
* Experience in a software or SaaS company and familiarity with multi\-tenant or cloud\-hosted environments.
* Exposure to SIEM or SOC operations and to security frameworks such as ISO 27001\.
* Practical experience deploying AI\-assisted operations tooling in a real environment.

Rehabbers are specialized contractors/developers who deal with old structures to be renewed. There are about ten competitors in this space, but none has an integrated product like ours. The market for software sales in this segment is about US$1 billion per year. We expect to extract about US$10 million per year from this pool. Organization: Johan Brown Publishing Pvt. Ltd.  
Location: Hyderabad  
Department: Student Wellness \& Mental Health Program  
Role Type: On\-site.  
Duration: 3–6 months

About Johan Brown Publishing Pvt Ltd

At Johan Brown Publishing, we are pioneering the world of SMART eBooks and digital innovation, blending technology with creativity to deliver impactful learning and entertainment experiences. Alongside our award\-winning projects like SAATH, KATHA, and O’WOW, we are equally committed to building a strong, people\-centric workplace that fosters growth, inclusivity, and collaboration.

About the Role

We are seeking a **Psychologist Intern** to support the on\-ground and programmatic implementation of **SAATH**, a mental wellness initiative designed in response to the growing need for preventive mental health systems in educational institutions.

The intern will work closely with psychologists, program coordinators, and school/college stakeholders to assist in:

· wellness screening \& documentation,

· psychoeducation delivery,

· referral pathways,

· training support for staff,

· and rollout of SAATH\-aligned wellbeing tools.

This internship is ideal for students/recent graduates looking for real\-world exposure in **developmental mental health, school psychology, preventive counselling systems, and mental health program implementation.**

Key Responsibilities

1\) SAATH Program Implementation Support

· Assist in implementation of the **SAATH framework:**  
**Support, Awareness, Acceptance, Therapy \& Healing**.

· Support onboarding and engagement of partner institutions (schools / colleges).

· Coordinate with internal teams for roll\-out of digital/structured wellness resources (“Therapedia” ecosystem).

2\) Student Wellness Support \& Documentation

· Assist in basic screening, intake, and mental wellness documentation (under supervision).

· Support safe and confidential workflows for identifying students at risk.

· Help maintain anonymized datasets, case logs, and program dashboards (non\-clinical only unless authorized).

3\) Psychoeducation \& Awareness Activities

· Support delivery of **awareness sessions** for students/teachers/parents (stress, anxiety, exam pressure, bullying, emotional regulation etc.).

· Contribute to creating stigma\-free messaging that frames help\-seeking as a strength and right.

4\) Teacher \& Stakeholder Support

· Assist in training facilitation support for teachers/staff (recognizing signs, escalation steps, early intervention).

· Support building institution\-level wellbeing workflows aligned with Supreme Court expectations for institutional responsibility.

5\) Reporting \& Program Evaluation

· Support monitoring impact indicators (reach, sessions conducted, referrals, engagement, feedback).

· Assist in compiling reports/presentations for leadership and partner institutions.

· Contribute insights for improving tool usability and adoption.

6\) Safe Zone Administration \& Student Support

· Assist in the implementation and administration of Safe Zone wellbeing systems across partner institutions.

· Support confidential student support workflows, ensuring safe, inclusive, and stigma\-free access to mental health resources.

· Coordinate with psychologists, counsellors, teachers, and institutional stakeholders to facilitate timely interventions and referral pathways.

· Contribute to Safe Zone awareness initiatives, peer\-support activities, and wellbeing campaigns that strengthen the institution's culture of care and psychological safety.

Skills \& Competencies

* Strong foundation in **psychology principles**, developmental psychology, basic counselling skills.
* Excellent communication (English \+ regional language is a plus).
* Comfort working with young adults and school systems.
* High ethical standards: confidentiality, consent, sensitivity.
* Ability to write documentation clearly and objectively.
* Interest in preventive mental health \& scalable wellness programs.

Eligibility Criteria

* Students / freshers pursuing or completed:
* BA/BSc Psychology
* MA/MSc Psychology
* Counselling Psychology / Clinical Psychology (preferred)
* Applied Psychology / School Psychology
* Must be available for internship duration (typically 3–6 months)

Benefits

· **Internship Stipend:** ₹8,000 per month.

· **Internship Certificate** upon successful completion.

· Potential to convert the internship into **full\-time employment**, with a **salary** based on performance and demonstrated capabilities.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 per month

description:
**Job Advertisement – Junior Production Engineer (Location: Vasai)**  
**Company Description:** SynThera Biomedical Pvt. Ltd. is an advanced materials startup focusing on R\&D, manufacture and commercialization of high\-purity specialty glass and advanced ceramics products for high tech sectors such as healthcare and electronics. The company has a rapidly growing technology portfolio (5 patents granted – 2 Indian and 3 International); 2 peer\-reviewed academic papers in international journals out of which it has conceptualized multiple products that are all the first of their kind to be developed in India. In fact, our patented/proprietary products are the first to be developed globally. These products are at different technology readiness levels and continuous work is ongoing to bring the most developed products to market by expanding our capabilities in manufacturing, marketing and sales. The Company is the recipient of multiple awards for its innovative work and enjoys a strong and rapidly expanding network of partners in industry and academia both within India and internationally. The core values of the company are encapsulated in its QAI philosophy: **Quality – Affordability – Innovation.**

**Job Summary:** As a Junior Production Engineer, you will have exciting opportunities to apply your technical knowledge in the manufacturing of the Company’s patented and off\-patent material products in the glass and ceramics domains. You will get to work with team members and stakeholders having diverse competencies in R\&D, quality control, and supply chain with considerable scope for cross\-functional training. At all levels, suggestions for improvement of existing manufacturing systems and processes will be encouraged. Your focus on precision and ability to meet production targets will help in completing critical deliverables. Your innovative approach to process optimization will facilitate in scaling complex technologies from lab\-scale to commercial production. The production outcomes supervised by you will have a major bearing on the future scalability and commercial success of the Company.

Key Responsibilities:

· **Manufacturing Operations:** Assisting in the day\-to\-day production of specialty glass and advanced ceramics, focusing on furnace operations and material synthesis.

· **Utility \& Systems Management:** Basic oversight and handling of critical production utilities including gas units (Oxygen/Argon), cooling systems, and specialized industrial units.

· **Process Monitoring:** Monitoring electrical parameters, including current and voltage stability, to ensure consistent heating and material processing.

· **Equipment Handling:** Operating production\-oriented machinery and applying basic principles of physics (thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and stress\-strain) to troubleshoot minor mechanical issues.

· **Technical Calculations:** Applying knowledge of physics units and conversion factors (pressure, temperature, flow rates) to ensure precise batch processing.

· **Quality \& Compliance:** Ensuring strict adherence to Quality Management Systems (QMS) and maintaining detailed production logs.

· **Reporting:** Reporting of Production Performance Metrics and utility consumption to Top Management.

Candidate Profile:

**Qualification:**

· **Degree/Diploma:** BE, BTech, or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, and Chemical Engineering.

· **Fresher Friendly:** This position is open to fresher’s or recent graduates who have a strong grasp of engineering fundamentals.

Essential Technical Knowledge:

· **Electrical Units:** Clear idea of current, voltage, and electrical units required for industrial equipment operation.

· **Gas \& Utility Systems:** Basic understanding of gas units (Oxygen, Argon, etc.), oxygen units, and industrial cooling/chiller units.

· **Applied Physics:** Strong foundational knowledge of physics units and a production\-oriented understanding of how machines work based on physical laws.

· **General Skills:** Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and proficiency in MS Office (Excel).

**Who can apply:** Only those candidates can apply who:

1\. Are available for full\-time (in\-office/on\-site) role in **Vasai**.

2\. Can start the job immediately.

3\. Are willing to work in a hands\-on manufacturing environment involving high\-temperature equipment.

4\. **Local candidates from Vasai will be preferred.**

5\. **Candidates applying from outside Vasai will be responsible for their own accommodation and travel arrangements.**

**Women wanting to start/restart their career are encouraged to apply.**

**Stipend/Salary:** Will be decided based on candidate profile and performance during interview.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

**About the Role** 




 We are developing intelligent early pest detection systems that integrate motion sensors, embedded electronics, and computer vision to detect and respond to real\-world pest activity in a given focal space.
 



 This role focuses on building and deploying working systems – not simulations or theoretical models.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ·      Design and develop sensor\-based detection systems (PIR, ultrasonic, microwave, thermal imaging, etc.)
 



 ·      Integrate camera modules with real\-time processing, detection
 



 ·      Build and program embedded systems (Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi)
 



 ·      Implement basic computer vision pipelines (OpenCV / edge AI models)
 



 ·      Develop trigger\-response logic (alerts, automation, deterrent mechanisms)
 



 ·      Test and optimize systems for outdoor and real\-world conditions
 



 ·      Rapid prototyping, debugging, and iteration
 



**Required Skills** 




 ·      Hands\-on experience with microcontrollers (Arduino / ESP32 / Raspberry Pi)
 



 ·      Experience working with physical sensors in real projects
 



 ·      Programming in Python and/or C/C\+\+
 



 ·      Ability to build and debug hardware\-software systems
 



**Preferred Skills** 




 ·      Experience with OpenCV / object detection / video analytics
 



 ·      Familiarity with IoT systems (data transmission, alerts, cloud integration)
 



 ·      Exposure to camera modules / embedded vision systems
 



 ·      Experience with edge AI devices
 



 ·      Basic understanding of electronics and signal processing
 



**Portfolio Requirement** 




 Applications without proof of work will not be considered.
 



 Please include:
 



 ·      GitHub / project links
 



 ·      Demo videos (if available)
 



 ·      Brief description of systems you have built
 



**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for candidates who:
 



 ·      Have built
 **real, working systems** 
 (not just academic assignments)
 



 ·      Can integrate
 **hardware \+ software \+ logic** 




 ·      Are comfortable working in
 **unstructured, real\-world environments** 




 ·      Can independently troubleshoot and iterate
 



**Location** 




 Express Pesticides Pvt. Ltd., Santacruz (West), Mumbai.
 



**How to Apply** 




 Send your application to
 **ea.epcorn@gmail.com** 




 Include:
 



 1\.    Resume (max 2 pages)
 



 2\.    Project portfolio (links required)
 



 3\.    Short note:
 *Describe one system you built and how it works* 




**Important Note** 




 This role is not suitable for candidates with only theoretical or coursework\-based experience.

title: Embedded Systems Specialist in Greater Noida
description:
Company Description HBeonLabs Technologies Private Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 certified electronics and IoT solutions company established in 2008, specializing in GSM\-based security systems and customized RFID\+GPRS\+GPS solutions. The organization focuses on end\-to\-end services, from research and design to manufacturing and deployment of embedded and IoT products tailored to client requirements and budgets. By integrating sensors, connectivity, and cloud\-based applications, HBeonLabs enables smarter decision\-making and improved product performance for businesses ranging from startups to large enterprises. The company emphasizes reliable, secure, and innovative solutions with fast, on\-time delivery and a strong commitment to quality throughout the product development lifecycle. With deep experience in embedded system technologies, HBeonLabs aims to build long\-term partnerships by ensuring high customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Role Description This is a full\-time, on\-site Embedded Software Developer (RTOS \+ OpenCPU) role based in Noida. The Embedded Software Developer will design, implement, and maintain embedded software for IoT and electronics products, with a focus on RTOS\-based and OpenCPU platforms. Responsibilities include developing firmware modules, integrating drivers and communication stacks (e.g., GSM, GPRS, GPS, RFID), and optimizing code for reliability, performance, and memory usage. The role involves debugging and troubleshooting hardware–software integration issues, using tools such as logic analyzers, debuggers, and protocol analyzers. The developer will collaborate closely with hardware, QA, and product teams to refine requirements, support prototyping, prepare technical documentation, and assist in product validation and field issue resolution.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Strong skills in Embedded Software Programming and Embedded Software development for microcontrollers and SoCs on OpnCPU and RTOS.
   

  

 Proficiency in Software Development practices, including version control, build systems, and testing for embedded environments.
   

  

 Ability to perform effective Debugging of embedded systems, including hardware–software integration and RTOS\-related issues.
   

  

 Experience in Software Design for real\-time and resource\-constrained systems, including modular architecture and code optimization.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS or similar) and OpenCPU\-based platforms for GSM/4G modules.
   

  

 Good understanding of communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, MQTT) and sensor/actuator interfacing.
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

 Ability to read schematics, collaborate with hardware teams, and document designs and test cases clearly.
   

  

 Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and willingness to work on\-site in a collaborative, fast\-paced product environment
   

  

 About Company: It is an ISO 9001: 2008 certified company, which started its business in the year 2008 and is valued for manufacturing and supplying a wide range of the finest quality educational \& industrial training projects. Inclusive of final year projects, GSM products, and GSM project kits, we offer a wide range of educational \& industrial training projects. These projects are designed using quality\-assured materials as per the industry\-set norms. Furthermore, we offer excellent educational workshops and industrial training services to our esteemed clients. Rendered by a pool of expert technicians, these services are highly appreciated among our clients for their effectiveness.
   

  

 Utilizing the skills and experience of the workforce, we have been able to cater to the precise needs of our valuable clients in the most efficient manner. Hassle\-free modes of payment are offered, keeping the ease of our clients in mind.

title: Front Desk Manager (Telesales)
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an energetic and result\-oriented Pre\-Sales Executive who will be responsible for generating business opportunities through a combination of tele\-calling, follow\-ups, business development visits, networking, and on\-ground lead generation activities. The role requires a proactive individual who can identify potential customers, engage them effectively, and create a strong pipeline for the sales team.

This is a performance\-driven role with an attractive incentive structure, offering significant earning potential for high performers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Tele Sales \& Lead Qualification**

* Make outbound calls to prospective customers from company databases, marketing campaigns, references, and self\-generated leads.
* Understand customer requirements and assess their interest level.
* Explain company products and services professionally.
* Qualify leads based on predefined criteria.
* Schedule meetings, site visits, or consultations for the sales team.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with interested prospects.
* Re\-engage dormant or inactive leads.

**Performance Metrics**

* Minimum call volume targets per day.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of appointments/site visits scheduled.
* Lead\-to\-meeting conversion ratio.
* Number of business development visits conducted.
* Number of leads generated through business development activities.
* Quality and conversion potential of generated leads.

**2\. Marketing \& Business Development**

* Conduct business development in assigned territories to identify potential customers.
* Visit residential communities, commercial establishments, business parks, retail locations, exhibitions, events, and networking forums.
* Generate direct leads through personal interaction and relationship building.
* Build referral networks with local businesses, channel partners, and influencers.
* Collect market intelligence and competitor information.

**3\. Lead Management \& Follow\-Up**

* Maintain a systematic lead tracking process.
* Ensure timely follow\-up of all assigned and self\-generated leads.
* Update lead status regularly in the CRM system.
* Maintain detailed records of customer interactions.
* Coordinate closely with the sales team to ensure smooth handover of qualified prospects.

**4\. Customer Engagement**

* Act as the first point of contact for prospective customers.
* Build trust and rapport through professional communication.
* Address initial customer queries and concerns.
* Ensure a positive customer experience during the pre\-sales stage.
* Maintain strong relationships with prospects throughout the sales cycle.

**5\. Target Achievement**

* Achieve monthly and quarterly consultation targets.
* Contribute to overall business growth through pipeline development.
* Support the sales team in achieving revenue objectives.

**6\. Working Schedule**

Working Days \- Wednesday to MondayWeekly Off – Tuesday

· Saturdays and Sundays are mandatory working days.

· Candidates should be comfortable working on weekends as these are key business days.

Working Hours – As per company policy and business requirements.Travel Requirement \- Regular local travel within the assigned territory is required. Desired Candidate ProfileEducation

* Graduate preferred.
* Relevant sales or marketing qualifications will be an advantage.

Experience

* 1–5 years of experience in Tele Sales, Pre\-Sales, Lead Generation, Business Development, or Customer Acquisition.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a sales\-oriented attitude may also apply.

Skills Required

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong persuasion and negotiation abilities.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Revon Unmanned Systems develops advanced indigenous unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and autonomous technologies for Defence and AgriTech applications. The company focuses on building innovative, reliable, and mission\-ready solutions that support surveillance, precision agriculture, and next\-generation aerial operations. Multidisciplinary engineering teams work closely to create robust platforms tailored to demanding field conditions. Joining Revon Unmanned Systems offers the opportunity to contribute to high\-impact systems that serve critical national and commercial needs. Team members are encouraged to innovate, collaborate, and advance cutting\-edge unmanned technologies.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Embedded Engineer role based in Hyderabad. The Embedded Engineer will design, implement, and optimize embedded software for UAV and autonomous systems, from low\-level drivers to application logic. Daily responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, integrating firmware with sensors, actuators, and communication modules, and conducting hardware\-in\-the\-loop and field testing. The role involves debugging and resolving issues on embedded targets, collaborating with hardware, avionics, and systems engineers, and contributing to software documentation and version control practices. The Embedded Engineer will also support continuous performance improvements, adherence to safety and reliability standards, and participation in design reviews for new product features and platforms.
 



**Qualifications** 




  




* Strong embedded software foundation, including Embedded Software Programming and Embedded Software design for resource\-constrained systems.
* Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting embedded systems, including use of debuggers, analyzers, and diagnostic tools.
* Experience in Software Development for real\-time or safety\-critical applications, with good understanding of software lifecycle and best practices.
* Familiarity with Internet of Things (IoT) concepts, communication protocols, and integrating devices into connected systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Hands\-on experience with microcontrollers, RTOS or bare\-metal development, and communication interfaces (e.g., UART, SPI, I2C, CAN).
* Knowledge of C/C\+\+ for embedded systems; exposure to scripting or automation tools is an advantage.

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, comfortable engaging with leadership and operational teams alike.

**What’s in it for you** 



* Competitive salary
* Provident fund
* Employee health insurance
* 24 days of annual leave
* Modern laptop
* Internet, transportation and phone allowance
* A modern, flexible, and multicultural workplace at an innovative and global company

**Our culture** 




 Working at Plat4mation evolves around working from your internal drive to make a difference for people in combination with having fun. We always go the extra mile to deliver on what we promise!  Your development is our number one priority. This means you get room to grow. We strongly believe that personal development and ambitions are key to our company’s success.  We are a global pure\-play ServiceNow partner that makes work flow. title: Manager – Compensation & Workforce Planning
description:
**Position Purpose** 




 The Manager – Compensation \& Workforce Planning will serve as a core specialist responsible for the end\-to\-end administration, analysis, and optimization of the organization's Total Rewards programs. This role bridges HR strategy and financial discipline by monitoring headcount against approved manpower budgets, managing group benefit plans, and leveraging advanced analytics to deliver actionable insights that drive retention, productivity, and strategic workforce cost optimization.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Compensation \& Total Rewards Management** 



* Maintain, review, and update internal compensation structures to ensure robust alignment with external market benchmarks.
* Drive the operational execution of the Annual Compensation Review cycles, providing critical data modeling and analytical inputs.
* Oversee and validate complex incentive and variable bonus calculations to ensure precision and compliance with corporate policies.
* Conduct regular internal parity assessments and analyze external salary survey outcomes to support equitable compensation decisions.



**2\. Benefits Strategy \& Plan Administration** 



* Manage the implementation, renewals, and day\-to\-day operations of all group employee benefit plans.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and advocate for employees, efficiently resolving queries and issues related to benefits coverage.
* Partner with external brokers and vendors to ensure seamless service delivery and optimized plan administration.



**3\. Workforce Planning \& Budgetary Control** 



* Track, monitor, and audit real\-time headcount numbers against approved organization\-wide manpower budgets.
* Perform comprehensive variance analyses, proactively highlighting financial risks, deviations, or structural overruns to leadership.
* Partner with Finance and Business HR (HRBPs) to evaluate compensation needs across different business verticals and ensure accurate cost allocation.



**4\. Reward Analytics \& People Cost Reporting** 



* Develop and deliver periodic reports on people costs, capturing key historical trends and forecasting future expenses for Strategic Workforce Planning.
* Assist in the compilation, monitoring, and governance of the overall HR budget.
* Utilize data analytics to identify opportunities for workforce cost optimization and productivity enhancement.

**Education \& Experience** 



* **Minimum Qualification:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
 **MBA in HR preferred.**
* **Experience:** 
 2\+ years of dedicated experience in Total Rewards, Compensation \& Benefits, and Manpower Budgeting. Exposure to the BFSI or insurance sector is an advantage.



**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies** 



* **Analytical Expertise:** 
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and VBA Macros. Experience with data visualization tools like Power BI is highly advantageous.

 Strong hands\-on expertise with HR Information Systems (HRIS) and a solid understanding of statutory compliance regulations.

 Exceptional stakeholder management capabilities with the ability to communicate financial and analytical data clearly to non\-technical business leaders.

title: Sourcing Specialist
description:
**Job Summary**
* This role is responsible for providing guidance on intricate matters of sourcing and assessing candidates, managing candidate experience, overseeing staffing operations and ensuring compliance with recruitment processes to facilitate successful talent acquisition. The role builds and nurtures relationships with hiring managers in a business and sub\-region while cultivating connections with influential decision\-makers. The role guides and oversees the attainment of hiring objectives encompassing time\-to\-fill, cost per hire, diversity, and candidate satisfaction.


**Responsibilities**
* Maintains relationships with hiring managers within a business and sub\-region; develops relationships with key decision\-makers.
* Drives and supervises the achievement of the hiring targets for the sub\-region, including time to fill, cost per hire, graduate, diversity, and candidate satisfaction.
* Manages the beginning\-to\-end staffing process within the sub\-region; implements sourcing strategies within the sub\-regions, screens candidates, provides a short list of candidates, coordinates interviews, creates offer letters, and facilitates relocation.
* Creates and posts job openings on various job boards and/or the company's career website, which includes writing job descriptions, formatting postings, and ensuring compliance with company policies and applicable laws.
* Assists in sourcing and identifying potential candidates through various channels, such as job boards, social media, referrals, and other recruitment sources.
* Schedules and coordinates interviews between candidates and hiring managers, including arranging interview logistics, sending interview confirmations, and coordinating travel arrangements, if applicable.
* Supports the onboarding process for new hires, including preparing and sending offer letters, conducting pre\-employment screenings, coordinating background checks, and ensuring completion of new hire paperwork.
* Provides a positive and professional candidate experience throughout the recruitment process by maintaining regular communication with candidates, responding to candidate inquiries, and providing timely updates on the status of their applications.
* Provides general administrative support to the talent acquisition team, such as scheduling meetings, preparing recruitment\-related documents, maintaining recruitment files, and performing other administrative tasks as needed.
* Counsels with managers on the hiring process and ensures that managers are in compliance with corporate and government policy.


****Education \& Experience** 
 Recommended**
* Four\-year or Graduate Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.

title: Team Lead - Capacity Planning
description:
**Role:**




 The Capacity Planner plays a crucial role in ensuring efficient resource allocation and optimal utilization of available capacity within the organization. This role involves analyzing historical data, forecasting future demand, and developing strategic plans to align workforce capacity with business requirements. The Capacity Planner collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams to identify capacity gaps, recommend solutions, and implement effective workforce management strategies.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:**



* Analyze historical data, trends, and patterns to forecast future demand for resources across various business units or projects.
* Develop and maintain capacity models, incorporating factors such as skill sets, workload fluctuations, and resource availability to ensure optimal resource utilization.
* Collaborate with project managers, operations teams, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand resource needs, and align capacity planning efforts with organizational goals.
* Monitor and report on capacity metrics, such as utilization rates, capacity gaps, and resource allocation effectiveness, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
* Identify potential capacity risks or bottlenecks and propose proactive mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity and meet service level agreements (SLAs).
* Participate in resource planning meetings, presenting capacity analysis and recommendations to support informed decision\-making.
* Develop and maintain capacity planning tools, templates, and dashboards to streamline data collection, analysis, and reporting processes.
* Stay up\-to\-date with industry best practices, trends, and emerging technologies in capacity planning and workforce management.



  





**Criteria:**



* Any Graduation
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in capacity planning, workforce management, or resource planning roles.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and derive actionable insights.
* Proficiency in using capacity planning tools, spreadsheet applications, and data visualization software.

 Master's Degree

**Your Role**
 Drive AI\-powered intelligence across Philips MRI service operations, transforming reactive maintenance into a predictive, self\-healing ecosystem that improves patient uptime worldwide.
   

  

* You will be a foundational member of the Digital \& AI team within MR Service Innovation, directly contributing to Philips’ “Autonomous MR” vision – building an MRI ecosystem that can detect, self\-heal, predict and ultimately operate autonomously. Your models and analyses will influence how thousands of MRI systems worldwide are serviced, directly improving scanner uptime, patient throughput and hospital outcomes.
* You will work in a lean, high\-impact team led by the Director of Digital \& AI, collaborating closely with R\&D engineering, field service operations, MR business leadership and global service platform teams. You will partner with external delivery organisations and have visibility into executive\-level decision\-making across the MR business unit.
* This role offers an exceptional growth trajectory: you will build hands\-on expertise in healthcare AI within a regulated MedTech environment, develop business\-case and stakeholder\-communication skills alongside technical depth, and gain exposure to the full lifecycle of AI programmes – from data exploration through deployment. There is a clear pathway toward senior data science and AI leadership roles as the programme scales.
* From flexible work arrangements to competitive health and wellness programmes, a career at Philips comes with all sorts of wonderful benefits. Be sure to speak to your recruiter about benefits in your region.


**You’re The Right Fit If**
* Experience: You have built, validated and deployed machine learning or statistical models on real\-world operational data. Exposure to service/maintenance analytics, time\-series forecasting, NLP on unstructured technical text or IoT/sensor data is a strong differentiator. Experience working with large\-scale CRM or ITSM datasets (e.g. Salesforce, ServiceNow) is valued.
* Skills: You are proficient in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit\-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow). You can work confidently with SQL, data visualisation tools and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP). You are comfortable translating analytical findings into business\-language insights for non\-technical stakeholders and can communicate complex results clearly.
* Education: You hold a Bachelor’s Degree or Vocational Education in Computer Science, Econometrics, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics or an equivalent quantitative discipline.
* Mindset: You thrive in ambiguity and are energised by building something from the ground up. You are curious about the healthcare domain, comfortable challenging assumptions with data, and motivated by the idea that your work will ultimately help keep MRI scanners running for the patients who depend on them.

title: Data Scientist/AI-ML
description:
The AI/ML Developer role is designed for innovative and technically skilled professionals who are passionate about building intelligent, data\-driven solutions using Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI technologies. This position focuses on designing, developing, deploying, and optimizing scalable AI\-powered applications that solve complex business challenges and enhance operational efficiency across enterprise environments.
   

  

 Professionals in this role will work closely with software engineers, data teams, architects, and product stakeholders to integrate advanced machine learning capabilities into modern applications and platforms. The position provides hands\-on experience in machine learning model development, natural language processing, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, semantic search, vector databases, and intelligent automation frameworks.
   

  

 The role requires expertise in Python development, data engineering, model training, API integration, and production deployment of AI solutions. Candidates will contribute to building enterprise\-grade AI applications using modern frameworks such as LangChain, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit\-Learn, and cloud\-based deployment environments. This opportunity is ideal for professionals seeking to advance their careers in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning Engineering, NLP, Generative AI, and intelligent software development while working on cutting\-edge technologies and real\-world innovation initiatives.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and AI\-powered applications for business use cases.
* Build predictive analytics models, anomaly detection systems, recommendation engines, and semantic search solutions.
* Develop and optimize Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) and modern AI frameworks.
* Design and implement LangChain\-based workflows, intelligent agents, and multi\-step AI automation pipelines.
* Build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions including document processing, chunking, indexing, and context retrieval.
* Develop data processing pipelines for data collection, cleansing, transformation, feature engineering, and model preparation.
* Create scalable Python\-based solutions for machine learning workflows and enterprise automation.
* Integrate AI models and intelligent services into business applications through RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Configure and manage vector databases for embedding storage, semantic search, and contextual information retrieval.
* Train, evaluate, fine\-tune, and optimize machine learning models for accuracy, scalability, and performance.
* Conduct model validation, hyperparameter tuning, benchmarking, and error analysis activities.
* Monitor model performance, inference behavior, latency, and operational metrics in production environments.
* Implement observability, telemetry, and model monitoring frameworks to ensure system reliability.
* Collaborate with software development, product management, and data engineering teams to deliver AI\-driven solutions.
* Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, stand\-ups, and technical review sessions.
* Troubleshoot data pipeline issues, model failures, performance bottlenecks, and deployment challenges.
* Maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, API specifications, model documentation, and training records.
* Research emerging AI technologies, open\-source frameworks, and Generative AI innovations to improve existing solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and AI platform optimization projects.
* Ensure AI applications follow security, compliance, scalability, and performance best practices.


 Key Skills
   

  

* Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Predictive Analytics
* Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Python Programming, Object\-Oriented Design, and Data Processing
* LangChain Development, AI Agents, and Workflow Automation
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, and Context Management
* Natural Language Processing (NLP), Text Analytics, and Semantic Search
* PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit\-Learn Frameworks
* Data Engineering, Feature Engineering, and Data Pipeline Development
* Vector Databases, Embedding Models, and Similarity Search
* REST API Development, Backend Integration, and Service Architecture
* SQL Databases, NoSQL Databases, and Query Optimization
* Model Training, Hyperparameter Tuning, and Performance Optimization
* Model Monitoring, Telemetry, and AI System Observability
* Statistical Analysis, Data Interpretation, and Mathematical Modeling
* Git Version Control, Branch Management, and CI/CD Concepts
* Software Development Best Practices, Testing, and Documentation
* Cloud\-Based AI Deployments, Scalability, and Infrastructure Awareness
* Problem Solving, Analytical Thinking, and Debugging Skills
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Stakeholder Communication, and Teamwork
* Continuous Learning, Research Mindset, and Emerging Technology Adaptability


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related fields.
* Master’s Degree in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Relevant certifications in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Cloud Technologies, or Data Science will be considered an added advantage.
* Candidates from diverse educational backgrounds with strong technical expertise, project experience, and demonstrated AI/ML capabilities are encouraged to apply.

title: Network Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Network Engineer to join our rapidly growing office in Mumbai. You'll be responsible for the design and management of both our enterprise and trading networks, optimising our systems for reliability, scalability and performance characteristics, like latency, to help us remain competitive in the market.
   

  

 Optiver’s bespoke infrastructure offers a diverse network engineering experience. Advance your career in a unique environment, where you'll be supported to find the simplest solutions to some of the most complex problems in the financial markets.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam, with offices in London, Chicago, Austin, New York, Sydney, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Mumbai. Established in 1986, today we are a leading liquidity provider, with close to 2,000 employees in offices around the world, united in our commitment to improve the market through competitive pricing, execution and risk management. By providing liquidity on multiple exchanges across the world in various financial instruments we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets. We provide liquidity to financial markets using our own capital, at our own risk, trading a wide range of products: listed derivatives, cash equities, ETFs, bonds and foreign currencies.
   

  

 In Asia Pacific, Optiver was one of the first global market makers to establish a presence in the region, with the incorporation our Sydney office in 1996\. Since then, we have expanded our footprint by establishing offices in Taipei (2005\), Hong Kong (2007\), Shanghai (2012\) and Singapore (2021\). The business in Mumbai is newly established and deemed to be an integral part of the APAC strategy, with an anticipation of significant growth over the coming years.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
   

  

  

* Providing technical expertise to support a high\-frequency trading environment
* Monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents across network, security, and systems infrastructure
* Automating and monitoring network infrastructure to improve reliability and reduce manual operational work
* Supporting end\-to\-end infrastructure deployments across data centres, offices, and global WAN environments
* Assisting with planned upgrades and maintenance including migrations, capacity expansions, and hardware or software upgrades
* Ensuring the stability and performance of WAN connectivity between data centres and colocations
* Contributing to capacity planning, connectivity improvements, and traffic flow optimisation
* Driving improvements in infrastructure reliability and performance, including evaluating new technologies for use in the trading platform
* Contributing to the standardisation and automation of our environments through Infrastructure as Code
* Collaborating with developers, researchers, and hardware engineers to provide a stable and scalable platform for trading systems


**What You'll Get**
 You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Driven by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high\-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle some of the most complex problems in the financial markets.
   

  

 In return for your expertise, you will have access to a range of Optiver perks, including:
   

  

  

* A performance\-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool, fostering a truly collaborative environment.
* The chance to work alongside diverse and intelligent peers in a rewarding environment.
* Continuous learning, development and upskilling opportunities.
* Daily breakfast, lunch, and an in\-house barista.
* Gym/Club membership, plus weekly massages.
* Corporate health insurance
* Uber business for daily commute
* Regular social events, including a company trip every two years.


**Who You Are**
* 3\+ years of experience working as a network engineer in an operational environment
* Strong troubleshooting skills across LAN, WAN, and firewall infrastructure
* Experience monitoring and operating international WAN networks
* Solid understanding of network transport and routing protocols such as TCP/UDP, OSPF, BGP, and Multicast
* Experience working in multi\-vendor network environments (e.g. Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto)
* Strong knowledge of L2/L3 networking, firewalls, and network security
* Experience using monitoring and telemetry systems to analyse network performance and capacity
* Comfortable working with Unix/Linux systems in data centre environments
* Experience managing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code approaches and tools such as Git, Terraform, or Ansible
* Ability to coordinate work with vendors, service providers, and remote smart hands
* Certifications such as Arista ACE, PCNSE, CCNP, or CCIE are a plus


**DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION**
 Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion.
   

  

 We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via careers@optiver.com.au.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
**The Company**
 Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
   

  

 We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
   

  

**Meet the team:** 
  

  

 Join a passionate team of engineers who are truly making a difference in the lives of people with diabetes. As a Systems Engineer at Dexcom India, you will act as a bridge between user needs and technical execution.
   

  

 We operate on a
 **"Full Stack" Systems Engineering model** 
 , meaning our engineers engage with the feature lifecycle end\-to\-end—from defining requirements to executing verification. We are a collaborative and innovative group dedicated to developing cutting\-edge mobile (Android/iOS) and medical device solutions that empower users to manage their health with confidence. If you are driven to make an impact and thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment, this is the team for you.
   

  

**Where You Come In**
* You will translate high\-level product vision, user needs, and transform them into detailed, testable technical requirements for our medical devices and associated mobile applications.
* You will create and maintain comprehensive System and Software Requirements Specifications (SRS), ensuring alignment with architecture and risk management frameworks.
* You will execute and manage requirements traceability using tools like Jama Connect, ensuring completeness, clarity, and consistency throughout the product lifecycle. You will generate and maintain verification trace matrices to demonstrate end\-to\-end coverage from requirements to test cases.
* You will collaborate with software, hardware, and test engineers to develop system and subsystem test strategies, plans, and test cases that validate all documented requirements.
* You will work closely with development and quality teams to resolve technical ambiguity and ensure the final product meets all clinical and user needs.
* You will apply Systems Engineering best practices throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring rigorous adherence to internal SOPs and external standards.


**What Makes You Successful**
* Systems Thinking: You have a solid understanding of Systems Engineering principles, ideally with exposure to BLE architecture, mobile application development (Android/iOS), or embedded systems.
* Regulatory Knowledge: You have a working knowledge of (or a strong desire to learn) industry standards such as IEC 62304 (Medical Device Software) and ISO 14971 (Risk Management) and how to write requirements that support them.
* Tool Proficiency: You are comfortable using requirement management tools (e.g., Jama Connect) and familiar with software development and tracking tools like Jira, TestRail, and GitHub.
* Communication: You are an articulate communicator, able to convey technical information clearly to diverse audiences and collaborate effectively across time zones.
* Agility: You bring a proactive mindset and a passion for developing high\-quality, user\-centric products. You are adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


**Nice To Haves**
* INCOSE Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP) certification.
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond documentation generation, and advanced prompt engineering techniques.
* Proven track record of leading complex systems engineering projects from concept through to commercialization.


*To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.*

title: SB-1439-AI Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for two AI Agent Architects to design and build production\-grade agentic AI systems. This is a deeply hands\-on engineering role centred on multi\-agent orchestration, advanced context management, and large language model (LLM) integration. It is open to early\-career engineers (0–3 years) and exceptional fresh graduates — what matters most is outstanding computer\-science fundamentals, strong data structures and algorithms (DSA) skills, and hands\-on ability with Python.
   

  

 You will work on the design of agent workflows and the context architecture that makes them reliable, accurate, and efficient, taking systems from prototype to production. The ideal candidate has a strong academic record, sharp problem\-solving ability, and genuine enthusiasm for going deep on the agentic AI stack.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Agent Orchestration \& Workflow**
* Design and implement multi\-agent workflows using LangGraph on Python with Pydantic structured output.
* Model complex, long\-running processes as stateful, resumable graphs with branching, looping, retries, and durable checkpointing.
* Implement safe pause/resume and human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) checkpoints.


**Context Engineering**
* Engineer context management as a first\-class subsystem — layered context, retrieval/indexing, and active working sets.
* Implement deterministic context selectors and filters, token\-budgeted prompts, and summarisation/compaction of long histories.
* Design typed context schemas so each agent step receives precise, high\-signal context.


**LLM Integration \& Retrieval**
* Integrate LLM providers (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, and self\-hosted models) using robust prompt engineering, tool calling, and structured output.
* Wire in retrieval — vector search and embeddings — and code\-intelligence techniques for working over large codebases.
* Contribute to model\-routing logic that balances task type, risk, latency, and cost.


**Quality, Evaluation \& Governance**
* Build evaluation and error\-analysis loops; treat failures as feedback that improves reliability over time.
* Implement verification and validation patterns and deterministic gates for agent outputs.
* Ensure agent decisions and context are observable, auditable, and reproducible.


**Collaboration**
* Partner with platform/infrastructure engineers on deployment, inference, persistence, and durable execution.
* Contribute to engineering standards, design reviews, and code quality.


**Required Technical Skills**
**Domain** 
**Skills \& Technologies** 
**Must / Preferred** 
**CS Fundamentals \& DSA** 
 Data structures, algorithms, complexity analysis, strong problem\-solving
 **Must** 
**Programming** 
 Python 3\.10\+ (async, typing); clean, idiomatic code
 **Must** 
**Agent Orchestration** 
 LangGraph — graphs/state machines, checkpointers, HITL interrupts
 **Must** 
**Context Engineering** 
 Layered context, selectors/filters, summarisation \& compaction, token budgeting
 **Must** 
**Agentic AI Development** 
 Multi\-agent design, tool calling, structured output, verification patterns
 **Must** 
**LLM Integration** 
 Anthropic \& OpenAI / Azure OpenAI SDKs, prompt engineering Preferred
 **Data Modelling** 
 Pydantic v2, JSON Schema / typed contracts Preferred
 **Retrieval** 
 Vector stores (e.g. Qdrant / Azure AI Search), embeddings Preferred
 **Context Protocol** 
 Model Context Protocol (MCP) — resources/tools, Streamable HTTP Preferred
 **Multi\-agent Frameworks** 
 CrewAI, Microsoft Agent Framework Preferred
 **Durable Workflows** 
 Temporal (long\-running, resumable flows) Preferred
 **Inference** 
 vLLM awareness (paged attention, batching, quantisation), model routing Preferred
   

  

**Qualifications \& Certifications**
* Strong academic record — B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science or a related field from a reputable institution (or equivalent).
* 0–3 years of experience; exceptional fresh graduates with outstanding fundamentals are encouraged to apply.
* Strong data structures, algorithms, and problem\-solving skills — a competitive\-programming track record (Codeforces / LeetCode / ICPC / similar) is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on Python, plus exposure to LLM / agentic AI through academic projects, internships, or work — with clear eagerness to go deep on LangGraph and context engineering.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Any recognised cloud certification (Azure / AWS / GCP) is a plus


**Soft Skills \& Cultural Fit**
* Strong analytical mindset with a structured approach to design, debugging, and root\-cause analysis.
* Clear written and verbal communication — able to explain agent and context design to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Collaborative team player who contributes to shared standards, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.


**What We Offer**
* Deep, hands\-on work with the modern agentic AI stack — LangGraph, MCP, and multi\-agent systems.
* High ownership and influence over architecture from an early stage.
* Competitive compensation with a structured performance review process.
* Professional development support — certifications, conferences, and access to emerging tooling.
* Collaborative, transparent culture with clear growth pathways toward Staff / Principal engineering.

title: Product Manager I
description:
**About The Team**
 Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rapacious growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e\-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers \- ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
   

  

 Fun fact: Nearly 5% of India’s households shop with us.
   

  

 As a Product Manager I, in our team, you will collaborate with Developers, other Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, and Engineers. We are driven by a ‘user\-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our PMs are driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ \& delivery \- not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
   

  

 But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Product Manager 1 who is passionate about solving high\-impact problems in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross\-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Market \& Customer Understanding: Understand the e\-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.


* Problem Identification \& Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology\-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross\-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go\-to\-Market Planning: Create a go\-to\-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption \& Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3\-month forward\-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.


**What You Will Need**
* Overall experience of 3\+ yrs with at least 2\+ yrs in product management in a tech\-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).


* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking.
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.
