**About Jarvis Technology \& Strategy Consulting:**




 Jarvis Technology \& Strategy Consulting is one of India’s leading political and policy consulting organizations, founded by socio\-entrepreneurs from premier institutions such as IIT, ISB, and NIT. With a strong presence across the country, Jarvis leverages data and technology to drive large\-scale political campaigns, design action\-oriented community outreach programs, enable targeted communications, and improve the effectiveness of government initiatives. The organization works at the intersection of policy, governance, strategy, and technology, offering young professionals a dynamic and fast\-paced work environment with significant learning and growth opportunities.
 



  





**About the Role:**




 We're looking for a
 **Product Manager** 
 who can take ownership of our products from idea to launch — and everything after. You'll work with our tech, design, QA, and business teams every day, making sure everyone is on the same page and that products are built right and shipped on time.
 



 You don't need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable talking to engineers, understanding how software is built, and translating business needs into clear product requirements.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO**




  





**Plan \& Document:**



* Create and maintain detailed PRDs that clearly define product scope, features, and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain structured documentation across all project phases, including meeting notes, decisions, and action items.
* Prepare and distribute release notes and product updates to relevant stakeholders post\-launch.



  





**Run the Project:**



* Facilitate regular team standups to track progress, identify risks, and remove blockers.
* Manage tasks and sprints in a project management tool, maintaining dashboards that provide real\-time visibility into project status.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication channels across business and technical stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.



  





**Work with Teams:**



* Be the bridge between Engineering, QA, Design, DevOps, and Business teams — align priorities and resolve dependencies before they become problems.
* Work with QA to make sure everything is properly tested before release.
* Do regular product usage reviews with the Ops team to understand how the product is being used in the real world.
* Proactively identify and address issues before they escalate.



  





**Demos \& Retrospectives:**



* Demo the product to internal teams, business stakeholders, and external partners at key project milestones.
* After each release, run a retrospective — separately with the project team and the business team — to capture what worked and what didn't.



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**




  





**Experience \& Skills
 
 :** 



* 3\+ years of experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you can explain complex things simply.
* Experience writing PRDs, managing project documentation, and running standups.
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA for task management, sprint planning, and dashboards.



  





**Technical Knowledge:**



* Comfortable working with engineering teams — you understand the basics of how software is built, including development cycles, sprints, and releases.
* Familiar with APIs and how systems talk to each other (you don't need to write code, but you should understand the concepts).
* Able to read and interpret basic technical documents, architecture diagrams, or data flows well enough to ask the right questions.
* Understanding of QA processes — what testing phases look like and what goes into a release checklist.
* Comfortable with tools like JIRA, Confluence, or similar platforms for documentation and project tracking.



  





**Mindset:**



* Detail\-oriented — things don't slip through the cracks with you.
* Proactive — you spot problems early and act on them without being asked.
* A team player who can work across very different kinds of people — developers, designers, and business leads alike.

title: Engineer, Project Documentation
description:
**Documentation Engineer**
 The Documentation Engineer is responsible for preparing and issuing technical supplier documentation in line with project specifications and timelines. The role supports projects led by a Project Manager and ensures that all documentation meets customer requirements defined in the purchase order.
   

  

 The DE collaborates with internal teams (such as design, instrumentation, and product teams) and external stakeholders to gather inputs. They also handle revisions and technical clarifications in coordination with customers and project stakeholders.
   

  

 The role involves delivering accurate documentation in collaboration with the document support team and reporting to the Documentation Manager and Project Manager.
   

  

 The DE is expected to proactively communicate project updates, resolve challenges, and contribute to continuous improvement and standardization of documentation processes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Clarify technical documentation details in coordination with the Project Engineer, customer, and other project teams (e.g., Product Selection team).
* Review and provide inputs/comments on incoming project documentation, including content and schedule, before the kick\-off meeting.
* Issue agreed documentation to the customer after completing the technical review.
* Monitor and communicate the documentation schedule and progress throughout the project lifecycle.
* Participate in project kick\-off meetings and prepare WBS and documentation schedules.
* Issue delivery documents as per the agreed timeline and maintain them in DMS (Kronodoc).
* Track and update document status in systems (DMS/PDM).
* Organize documentation with Document Assistants and Engineers.
* Communicate progress, resolve issues, and report to stakeholders.
* DE will be in interaction with multiple interest groups: customers, project managers, project teams, sales, marketing and RTD on daily basis.


**Skills And Qualifications**
* Diploma or B.E./B.Tech. in Engineering or a related discipline, with a few years of experience in an engineering role.
* Knowledge of field devices and/or experience with documentation management systems is an added advantage.
* Systematic, cooperative, and customer\-oriented approach.
* Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining attention to detail and timelines.
* Strong communication skills with good command of written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.


**We offer**
 We offer a supporting team and interesting and challenging task in a truly global workplace. We have an environment that combines result\-driven and respectful culture in an exceptional way. You will be supported by a friendly team and an open, friendly, and respectful working culture.
   

  

**To Succeed**
 To succeed in this position, you should have hands\-on attitude towards the work. You should be able to solve problems with different stakeholders and willing to bring up development ideas and new best practices. On the other side you should have the ability and earlier experience from tasks where your tasks have required paying close attention to details and working individually for long time periods. Documentation has deadlines which must be respected. While following schedules of multiple projects you are able and willing to communicate of possible problems and do necessary follow up in solving them. It is considered as an advantage if you have experience in using DMS systems. A good command of MS Word and MS Excel and preferably Adobe programs. You speak and write English fluently. Any other language is an advantage.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 As an engineer on the reporting team, we expect you to have a good understanding of everything data, as well as back\-end code development. Your day to day work will involve owning the designing and execution of medium complexity features. This position will demand critical thinking skills, ability to quickly understand existing systems and the ability to work in agile, fast paced environments. The ability to take smart and educated risks is essential to the success of this position.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Own feature delivery end to end from ideation to deployment and monitoring
* Participate in the team's on call rotation and help triage alerts and incidents
* Review other team member's code and design document
* Suggest and own improvement to the system and coding standards


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 2\+ years of related experience
* Experience with one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Java, C\#, Go, Python) and solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design)
* Experience developing and delivering production features with high\-quality code and reliable tests (unit, component, contract, integration, end\-to\-end, performance); designs for testability
* Experience participating in code reviews and adhering to team guidelines and best practices
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, debugging pipeline issues, and analyzing system logs
* Experience with public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP), containers (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes)
* Experience with monitoring, metrics, logging, and building basic telemetry for features
* Experience participating in on\-call using service runbooks/SOPs and performing root cause analysis with minimal guidance


**Preferred**
* Comfort working across multiple components and with external dependencies in complex environments
* Strong communication and collaboration skills; able to work effectively with cross\-functional partners
* Track record of independently owning and delivering features end\-to\-end
* Experience authoring and owning testing plans for features and identifying patterns in test failures
* Experience contributing to and improving deployment pipelines and test automation systems
* Experience designing for scalability, reliability, and performance; writes extensible, shareable code and raises the bar through thoughtful code reviews
* Experience defining useful metrics/targets and measurably improving engineering processes and best practices
* Exposure to distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, and/or event\-driven architectures
* Hands\-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases, performance testing, and optimization
* Comfortable collaborating in a global, distributed team and working across time zones


 Life at Docusign
   

  

**Working here**
 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
   

  

 We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
   

  

**Accommodation**
 Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.
   

  

 If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
   

  

 Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice

**Meet the Team**
 The Cisco SD\-WAN dataplane team is at the forefront of innovation, designing and implementing the high\-performance, intelligent packet forwarding engine that powers Cisco's industry\-leading SD\-WAN solutions.  As a Senior Software Engineer on the SD\-WAN dataplane team, you will play a critical role in architecting, developing, and optimizing the high\-performance data plane for Cisco's SD\-WAN platform. You'll have the opportunity to influence the technical direction of our product, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver exceptional networking experiences. As we integrate AI and ML capabilities, you will be instrumental in developing intelligent packet processing mechanisms that adapt to real\-time network conditions and predict potential issues.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on systems programming and networking protocols.

* Experience with network data plane development, including concepts like packet processing, QoS, routing protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF), and tunneling technologies (e.g., IPsec, GRE).
* Demonstrated ability to debug complex system\-level issues and optimize performance in high\-throughput environments.
* Proven experience implementing and optimizing critical data plane security and resiliency features, including NAT/PAT, High Availability (HA) failover mechanisms, and stateful service processing.
* Proficiency in using AI\-assisted coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or similar platforms, to improve developer productivity, streamline code reviews, and maintain high standards of code maintainability.
* Experience with concurrent programming, multi\-threading, and performance tuning in large\-scale distributed systems.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with Linux kernel development, DPDK, or other high\-performance packet processing frameworks.

* Exposure to AI/ML concepts and their application in network optimization, anomaly detection, or predictive analytics.

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 D2C selling made as easy as selling on e\-com marketplaces

There are \~500k\-1M sellers who can sell D2C but can at best sell on marketplaces Philosophically \- we feel brand owners should spend most of their time on the product and not on channel optimizationShopify / Status\-quo software solve for work\-flow management of storefront but don’t do enough on “helping” merchants sell well!**

description:
We are seeking dynamic Portfolio Data Analysts to join our team and collaborate closely with our founders, financial analysts, product managers, and engineers. In this role, you'll play a pivotal part in supporting our client onboarding and success team. You'll need a strong ability to analyze financial data, translate insights into actionable strategies, and effectively guide clients through our platform's features to drive their success. This is a hybrid role based out of Arcana’s Coimbatore office.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Analyze and onboard portfolio data from various sources into Arcana's data integration ecosystem.
* Collaborate with engineering, product management, and data operations teams to deliver high\-quality, timely, and reliable data solutions through Arcana's platform.
* Work with a range of third\-party data providers to integrate their data into Arcana's system.
* Develop and support data aggregation solutions based on client and third\-party content, tailored to user workflow needs.
* Collaborate with user experience, design, and project management teams to develop data\-oriented workflow solutions and product enhancements.
* Analyze and implement solutions to improve data operations and pipeline efficiency.
* Understand Arcana's products and clients, working closely with internal stakeholders to identify new opportunities to serve clients and grow the business.

* GPA of 8\.0\+
* Data analysis experience with exposure to finance and investment management.

description:
**Corporate Relations Officer**

**Location:** Thane  
**Experience:** 5\+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic and result\-oriented **Corporate Relations Officer** to strengthen our corporate network, drive learner placements, and build strategic partnerships with organizations across industries. The ideal candidate will play a key role in connecting talent with employment opportunities while enhancing the company's corporate outreach and brand presence.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and generate corporate leads for learner placements, recruitment drives, training programs, and strategic partnerships.
* Build, nurture, and maintain long\-term relationships with existing and prospective corporate partners.
* Act as the primary point of contact for corporate clients and ensure timely coordination of hiring requirements.
* Schedule and facilitate a minimum of **30 interviews per month** with corporate partners.
* Achieve monthly placement targets through proactive business development and employer engagement initiatives.
* Plan and execute innovative engagement programs to strengthen corporate partnerships and employer branding.
* Design and implement **BTL (Below The Line) marketing campaigns** to generate organic leads and increase market visibility.
* Coordinate placement drives, campus hiring activities, networking events, and employer meetings.
* Maintain accurate records of corporate interactions, interview schedules, placement outcomes, and partnership activities in CRM systems.
* Prepare regular reports on placement performance, corporate engagement activities, and business development initiatives.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Human Resources, or a related field.
* Minimum **5 years of experience** in Corporate Relations, Placements, Recruitment, Business Development, or Client Relationship Management.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to build and sustain long\-term corporate partnerships.
* Experience using CRM platforms, bulk email tools, WhatsApp automation tools, and MS Office applications.
* Strong networking capabilities and a consultative approach to relationship building.
* Target\-driven mindset with the ability to consistently achieve placement and partnership goals.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills with attention to detail.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in the Education, EdTech, Training, Skill Development, or Placement Services industry.
* Existing network of HR professionals, Talent Acquisition teams, and corporate decision\-makers.
* Experience conducting placement drives, job fairs, or corporate hiring initiatives.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with a leading education and career development organization.
* Extensive exposure to corporate networking and partnership management.
* High\-growth, performance\-driven work environment.
* Career advancement opportunities and leadership exposure.
* Attractive compensation and performance\-based incentives.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Minimum 30 corporate interviews scheduled per month.
* Achievement of monthly placement targets.
* Number of new corporate partnerships onboarded.
* Corporate engagement and retention rate.
* Placement conversion ratio.
* Revenue contribution from partnerships and training collaborations

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

description:
**Job Summary**

Scaling both organically and through M\&A activity, the company has just implemented a functional organisation structure and needs to strengthen HR capabilities at the core.

Based in Pune, India and working alongside the Regional HR Manager, you will help drive HR functional expertise in Talent Acquisition both locally and in support of the wider global business. You will support in group\-wide HR initiatives and deploy talent acquisition strategies \& tools. You will interface with the HR team around the globe to support their TA needs for specialist and hard to fill roles.

 Full cycle recruitment experience within an agency and/or in house.

 Good industry knowledge with best recruitment practices

 Ability to multi\-task and work in an agile and fast paced environment.

 Expert knowledge of recruitment, focusing on digital and social media resources, applicant tracking systems, and creative sourcing techniques.

 must possess exceptional drive and motivation to achieve hiring goals.

 Excellent follow\-up skills and ability to work independently.

 Have excellent interpersonal, communication and problem\-solving skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

 Manage end\-to\-end Talent Acquisition: sourcing, screening, interviews, assessments, stakeholder approvals, and pre\-boarding.

 Represent the company at approved recruitment events.

 Lead sourcing initiatives and location\-based projects.

 Collaborate with HR and Operations to improve hire quality and retention.

 Support the implementation of and manage the ATS.

 Collaborate with hiring managers to understand the key business and cultural fit needs for vacant roles.

 Recommend process improvements aligned with business needs.  Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders.

 Prepare recruitment reports to support strategy development.

**Academic Qualification**

 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in human resources management or similar field

 Relevant certifications in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or HR Systems/ATS platforms would be beneficial.

**Competencies/Capabilities Required**

 Strong understanding of end\-to\-end recruitment processes and contemporary talent acquisition practices.

 Proven ability to source candidates through multiple channels, including digital platforms, social media, networking, and direct sourcing techniques.

 Good knowledge of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics/reporting tools.

 Ability to manage multiple hiring requirements simultaneously within a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.

 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build effective working relationships across functions and geographies.

 Excellent interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.

 High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.

**Accountability**

 Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for assigned positions across functions and geographies.

 Ensure timely closure of positions while maintaining quality\-of\-hire standards.

 Drive sourcing strategies using digital platforms, social media, networking, referrals, and market mapping techniques.

 Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

 Maintain accurate recruitment data, reports, and hiring metrics through the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

 Ensure compliance with recruitment processes, policies, and governance standards.

description:

Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ\+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each and every one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences.  

  

You will be working as HR Operations Team Lead – ELC and reporting to the Hub Delivery Manager – ELC, HR Operations, based in Bangalore, India. In this role, you will be leading a team of 10\+ members across multiple clusters and will take full accountability for the end\-to\-end Employee Lifecycle Management (ELC) process, delivering high\-quality services against globally agreed performance targets. You will ensure a high degree of customer experience by committing to complete, accurate, and timely completion of HR transactions. You will support the globally set standards for HR Operations and ensure that local legal and regulatory requirements — including country specific laws and compliance — are adhered to within the HR Operations Hub processes.

**Your Responsibilities**
=========================

* Driving the end\-to\-end HR Operations across one or more Countries and/or Service Lines, with oversight of multiple clusters and direct supervision of Junior Team Leads and their respective reporting teams.

* Leading and managing a team of 10\+ members, allocating work effectively across clusters, building team capability, and ensuring adequate backup strength and business continuity for key roles.
* Handling tough conversations, managing performance discussions, and driving accountability across direct and indirect reports. Supporting Junior Team Leads in addressing team\-level performance and development needs.

* Supporting the Hub Delivery Manager in implementing global initiatives such as acquisitions, divestments, new policies, and change programs within the respective team(s).

* Bachelor's degree in any stream; a postgraduate degree or MBA in HR is preferred.
* Minimum 8 to 10\+ years of experience in HR Shared Services / HR Operations in a global organization.
* Minimum 5\+ years of people management experience, including managing Team Leads or senior individual contributors.
* Proven experience managing a team size of 10\+ members across multiple clusters or geographies.
* Demonstrated ability to handle escalations, conduct tough performance conversations, and drive outcomes in a high\-pressure environment.
* Strong working knowledge of India labor laws, statutory compliance, and HR regulatory requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with HR tools: ServiceNow, Workday, and SAP are mandatory.
* Ability to leverage AI technology in HR Operations.
* Proficiency in MS Office; excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong analytical skills, a collaborative solutions\-oriented approach, and ability to manage multiple demands simultaneously.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-transaction, multi\-tasking team environment.
* Flexible to work in varied shifts as required by business needs.

ABB Business Services organization delivers operational and expert services in Finance, Human Resources, Information Systems, Legal, Global Travel Services, and external Customer Contact Centers. title: Fresher Hardware Engineer (Embedded Systems & Robotics)
description:
**About the Role :**  
We are building low\-cost, practical robotics and IoT hardware products for real\-world use. As our Hardware Engineer , you will take full ownership of designing, prototyping, and scaling embedded hardware solutions from idea to production. You will work hands\-on with microcontrollers like ESP32 and Arduino to create reliable, affordable products that include sensors, wireless connectivity, actuators, and power\-efficient designs.

This is a high\-impact role where your college projects will directly translate into real products. You will help us keep hardware costs minimal while delivering functional, production\-ready robotics and IoT devices.

**Key Responsibilities :**  
\- Design, prototype, and iterate on embedded hardware products using ESP32, Arduino, and similar microcontrollers.  
\- Develop and optimize firmware for features such as sensor integration, wireless communication (Wi\-Fi/Bluetooth), data logging, actuator control, and configurable operation.  
\- Create and refine custom PCB designs with focus on low BOM cost and easy manufacturing.  
\- Integrate various components (sensors, cameras, motors, power modules, etc.) into complete robotics/IoT systems.  
\- Implement power optimization techniques (deep sleep, battery/solar compatibility) for efficient, long\-running devices.  
\- Test, debug, and improve hardware reliability, including Wi\-Fi stability, environmental testing, and enclosure design.  
\- Collaborate with backend/software teams to ensure smooth data transmission and cloud/IoT integration.  
\- Prepare BOMs, documentation, and support small\-batch production and scaling to higher volumes.

**Must\-Have Requirements :**  
\- Proven College Project Experience (Mandatory): You must have already built and demonstrated working hardware projects during college using ESP32 or Arduino for example, robotics prototypes, IoT devices with sensors/actuators, wireless data transmission, or any similar embedded system.  
\- Strong hands\-on expertise in:  
\- ESP32 and Arduino platforms (programming, peripherals, Wi\-Fi/Bluetooth)  
\- Firmware development (Arduino IDE or ESP\-IDF)  
\- Basic electronics, soldering, prototyping, and troubleshooting  
\- Basic knowledge of PCB design tools (KiCad / EasyEDA) and component sourcing.  
\- Passion for building cheap, reliable, and practical hardware products from scratch.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills :**  
\- Experience with custom PCB fabrication services (JLCPCB/PCBWay) and cost optimization.  
\- Familiarity with sensors, motors, cameras, or other robotics components.  
\- Basic Python scripting for testing or automation.  
\- Knowledge of 3D printing or enclosure design for prototypes.

**What We Offer :**  
\- End\-to\-end ownership of hardware products right from Day 1\.  
\- Real exposure to production scaling (prototype → 100–1000\+ units).  
\- Competitive fresher salary \+ performance bonus.  
\- Fast learning curve in embedded hardware, robotics, and IoT product development.  
\- Flexible work environment with room to experiment and innovate.

If you have already built and showcased ESP32 or Arduino\-based hardware projects in college, this role is perfect for you.

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

* 1\. Have you ever sent a PCB for fabrication or worked on BOM/component sourcing?
* 2\.Are you available to work onsite in Hyderabad, Telangana?

* 4\.Are you from 2024 / 2025 / 2026 batch?

* 10\. Which microcontrollers have you worked with?

\- ESP32

\- Others

* 11\. Have you written firmware for any of the following?

\- Data logging

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**Job Role: UI/UX Designer**
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1\-3 Years
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented
 **UI/UX Designer** 
**experience** 
 to join our team in Hyderabad.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be able to take ownership of the complete design journey — from understanding product requirements and user needs to creating intuitive web and mobile experiences. You will work closely with product managers, stakeholders, and developers to ensure the final product is visually polished, user\-friendly, and aligned with the intended design vision.
   

  

 This role is best suited for someone who enjoys solving UX challenges, designing clean and modern interfaces, building interactive prototypes, and collaborating with development teams to bring designs to life.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**End\-to\-End Design Ownership**
* Understand product requirements, business goals, and stakeholder inputs.
* Translate requirements into clear user goals, user flows, and interface solutions.
* Create low\-fidelity and high\-fidelity wireframes for web and mobile applications.
* Design modern, visually balanced, and user\-friendly interfaces.
* Review implemented designs and support QA to ensure design accuracy during development.


**Mobile\-First UI Design**
* Design intuitive and responsive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.
* Follow platform guidelines such as Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design.
* Create adaptive layouts for mobile phones, tablets, and different screen sizes.
* Maintain usability, visual consistency, and accessibility across platforms.


**High\-Fidelity Visual Design**
* Design UI systems, screens, and reusable components using Figma or Adobe XD.
* Create visually rich layouts with strong design fundamentals, including typography, spacing, grids, color systems, and visual hierarchy.
* Use Adobe Photoshop for advanced visual assets, editing, masking, and compositing.
* Ensure all designs are clean, scalable, and development\-ready.


**Prototyping and Interaction Design**
* Build interactive prototypes to demonstrate user flows and screen transitions.
* Design micro\-interactions and motion concepts where required.
* Use tools such as Figma Advanced Prototyping, Framer, or similar platforms to validate design ideas.
* Present design concepts clearly to stakeholders and internal teams.


**Developer Collaboration**
* Prepare clear design specifications, assets, and handoff documentation for developers.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams to reduce implementation gaps.
* Support developers during the build phase by clarifying design behavior, spacing, responsiveness, and interaction details.
* Ensure the final product matches the intended design vision.


**Required Skills And Experience Design Tools**
* Strong proficiency in Figma or Adobe XD.
* Advanced knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, including non\-destructive editing, masking, compositing, and image enhancements.
* Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator is a plus.


**UX and Design Fundamentals**
* Strong understanding of wireframing, user flows, and information architecture.
* Good knowledge of usability principles and user\-centered design.
* Excellent visual design sense with attention to typography, spacing, color, layout, and consistency.
* Ability to create clean, structured, and intuitive user experiences.


**Mobile Design Awareness**
* Experience designing mobile application interfaces.
* Understanding of responsive and adaptive design across devices.
* Familiarity with mobile development frameworks such as Flutter or React Native is helpful.
* Ability to design keeping mobile usability, gestures, and platform patterns in mind.


**Prototyping and Motion**
* Ability to create clickable and interactive prototypes.
* Basic understanding of motion design and micro\-interactions.
* Exposure to tools such as Lottie, Adobe After Effects, or similar tools is an advantage.


**Technical Awareness**
* Basic knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3\.
* Understanding of responsive design principles.
* Ability to communicate effectively with developers and understand technical limitations.
* Experience in design handoff and developer collaboration.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience using AI\-assisted design tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or similar tools.
* Ability to blend modern UI design with cultural, traditional, or regional aesthetics.
* Exposure to scalable design systems, component libraries, and UI documentation.
* Interest in emerging design trends, AI tools, and product experience improvements.


**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who:
   

  

* Can think from both a user and business perspective.
* Has strong ownership of design quality from concept to implementation.
* Can create polished, modern, and practical UI designs.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced product environment.
* Can collaborate well with developers, product teams, and stakeholders.
* Has a strong portfolio that demonstrates both UX thinking and visual design skills.


 UI/UX Design,Design Tools,Mobile Design

 The location is based out of Pune.

title: HR Interns
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive HR Intern with a strong interest in Indian Labour Law and Compliance Implementation. In this role, you will help bridge the gap between statutory requirements and daily HR operations. You will support the HR department in auditing existing practices, drafting compliant policies, and ensuring our organization adheres to the latest Central and State\-specific labor regulations in India.
   

  

 This is an ideal opportunity for a student or recent graduate pursuing an MBA in HR, a Master’s in Labour Studies (MLS), or a Bachelor of Laws (LLB) to gain hands\-on experience in a corporate compliance environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Statutory Research \& Monitoring


 Conduct research on the four new Labour Codes (Wage, Social Security, Industrial Relations, and Occupational Safety) and their phased implementation.
   

  

 Track updates regarding state\-specific Shops and Establishments Acts and Professional Tax requirements.
   

  

 Assist in mapping Central and State\-specific compliance requirements to internal HR processes.
   

  

* Policy Drafting \& Indian Compliance


 Assist in updating the Employee Handbook to ensure compliance with the Standing Orders Act and local leave policies.
   

  

 Support the POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Committee with administrative tasks, awareness posters, and documentation of training sessions.
   

  

 Draft Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for grievance redressal as per the Industrial Disputes Act.
   

  

* Compliance Auditing \& Payroll Support


 Perform audits of employee files to ensure mandatory documentation (Aadhaar, UAN, PAN, nomination forms) is complete.
   

  

 Review job descriptions to ensure alignment with Code on Wages definitions (e.g., distinguishing between 'Worker' and 'Employee' categories).
   

  

 Assist with "Statutory Health Checks" including EPF, ESI, and Gratuity record\-keeping.
   

  

* Training \& Education


 Help design internal training materials for managers on the POSH Act and the Maternity Benefit Act.
   

  

 Prepare FAQs on Indian tax deductions (TDS) and social security benefits to help employees understand their pay slips.
   

  

* Employee Relations \& Onboarding


 Support the HR team in drafting offer letters and employment contracts that comply with the latest Indian judicial precedents.
   

  

 Ensure all exit formalities align with statutory requirements for full and final (F\&F) settlements.
   

  

**Requirements \& Qualifications**
 Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA (HR), Master of Labour Studies (MLS), or LLB.
   

  

 Legal Literacy: Foundational knowledge of Indian Labour Laws (e.g., Factories Act, EPF Act, ESI Act, POSH Act, and Payment of Bonus Act).
   

  

 Attention to Detail: High level of precision in reviewing statutory registers and employee records.
   

  

 Confidentiality: Absolute discretion in handling sensitive employee data and PII (Personally Identifiable Information).
   

  

 Communication: Strong writing skills in English; proficiency in Hindi or other regional languages is an added advantage for interpreting local state rules.
   

  

 Learning Objectives
   

  

 By the end of this internship, the candidate will have:
   

  

 Developed a practical understanding of how Indian Labour Laws translate into corporate policy.
   

  

 Gained experience in risk mitigation, statutory filing processes, and HR auditing.
   

  

 Built a portfolio of drafted policies and compliance communication materials.
   

  

 Learned the complexities of managing compliance across different Indian states.

title: Global Product Analyst (Level: Manager)
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As an HR Senior Product Analyst within BCG’s HR IT Systems Group, you will play a key role in the global implementation of our vendor management and external workforce system i.e. SAP Fieldglass. Working closely with the Transformation Product Owner, you’ll act as a functional expert, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to support requirements, analyze, design, and implement system solutions that align with business goals and compliance standards.


You will help translate business objectives into scalable system solutions that support global contingent workforce and services procurement processes.


You’ll collaborate with Product teams, IT colleagues, and HR stakeholders globally to continuously improve Fieldglass’ ability to meet evolving business needs in external workforce management.


You will also contribute to the strategic roadmap for Fieldglass, enabling more effective engagement of contingent labor and services procurement while enhancing user satisfaction and data\-driven insights.


You will act as a key liaison between senior HR and procurement leadership and the delivery team, owning stakeholder communication, escalation management, and alignment across global and regional business units.


You will oversee workstream planning and sprint governance, ensuring backlog health, milestone tracking, and on\-time delivery across cross\-functional Agile teams.


Among your responsibilities, you will:

* Gather and document global and regional business requirements
* Support design workshops and process mapping sessions
* Translate functional requirements into detailed configuration specifications
* Support system integrations with Workday, SAP S4HANA, and Coupa
* Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and SIT
* Validate data migration and perform reconciliation activities
* Assist in preparing deployment documentation and hypercare support
* Maintain comprehensive functional documentation
* Manage Product Backlog and agile delivery across sprints in partnership with Product Owner and scrum lead.
* Managed senior stakeholder relationships across, program, HR, Finance, Procurement and technology functions.
* Strive to ensure user stories are high quality as per agile best practices.

  

What You'll Bring

* 5–8 years in HR systems, VMS, procurement systems, or business systems as business analyst or support role
* 2\+ years hands\-on experience with SAP Fieldglass in an analyst or support capacity is required
* Experience participating in at least one SaaS implementation preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Strong background in HR operations, especially around contingent workforce or vendor management
* Proven experience gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into system specifications
* Skilled in creating functional documentation and understanding technical implications of proposed changes
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to assess design changes from a system\-wide perspective
* Excellent communication skills and ability to build partnerships with internal stakeholders
* Experience managing application configurations and executing thorough test plans
* Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint for reporting, analytics, and presentation
* Familiarity with data privacy practices, especially as they relate to external workforce data
* Experience in a global and agile working environment is preferred
* Knowledge of system integrations, especially with procurement platforms like Coupa or HRIS systems like Workday is a plus

  

Who You'll Work With

* Other members of the transformation team, including support teams
* Global HR, procurement, Finance and data stakeholders managing contingent labor, vendor relationships and payments
* Agile delivery teams, including developers, QA, product owners, and change managers
* External partners like implementation partner, MSP and technical teams supporting SAP Fieldglass integrations

  

Additional info

**You’re Good At:**


In this global role, you will work with stakeholders, team members, and customers around the world. You should thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment and demonstrate a strong focus on stakeholder needs and user experience.

* Translating complex business requirements into actionable SAP Fieldglass requirements for technology teams (configurations, integrations, data etc.)
* Supporting the Fieldglass Product Owner in planning and delivering transformation
* Supporting global template design and localization efforts
* Managing detailed documentation in a structured manner
* Demonstrating strong critical thinking skills when evaluating the broader impacts of system changes
* Working in fast\-paced transformation environments
* Managing and prioritizing backlog items using tools like Jira, ensuring timely delivery through agile sprint cycles
* Staying up to date with SAP Fieldglass trends, releases, and best practices to recommend future improvements

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

You will hold the keys to our company’s scale focusing on fostering a high\-performance culture, integrating smart HR technology, and ensuring our talent pipeline remains resilient in an evolving GCC market. You will partner directly with our senior leadership team and HR leadership in building the teams that will ship and shape our next generation of solutions creating long lasting positive impact to our customers. If you thrive to navigate a complex transition: moving from traditional administration to becoming a digital\-first, strategic business architect in a competitive market and want to see your fingerprints on the growth of a high\-speed purpose driven organization, this is your seat at the table.
   

  

* OneMagnify is an AI native, platform\-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.

 We are looking for an HR leader who can help shape the next phase of growth for our India Global Delivery Centre. This role goes beyond traditional HR operations and focuses on building scalable people strategies, strengthening organizational capability, and creating a high\-performance, digital\-first workplace culture.
   

  

 As an HR Manager, you will partner closely with business leaders, HR leadership, and cross\-functional teams to align talent strategies with business outcomes. You’ll help drive workforce planning, leadership development, HR transformation, employee experience, and compliance initiatives while supporting the growth of an AI\-native and platform\-enabled organization.

You’ll help build organizational structures, leadership pipelines, and employee programs that support business growth, delivery excellence, and long\-term scalability.
   

  

 You’ll partner with leadership teams to improve workforce planning, strengthen employee engagement, and modernize HR operations through AI\-enabled processes and data\-driven decision\-making. Your work will contribute to building resilient teams capable of supporting integrated customer experience, analytics, engineering, and digital platform initiatives across global markets.

* Drive employee engagement, retention, and workplace experience initiatives across teams

* Partner with HR and leadership teams to maintain compliant, employee\-focused workplace policies
* Act as a key advisor and contributor to POSH and workplace ethics initiatives
* Support Performance and Organizational Growth

* Collaborate cross\-functionally with HR, operations, finance, leadership, and delivery teams to maintain organizational alignment
* Contribute to building a high\-performance culture that supports business growth and employee success
* What You'll Need
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
* MBA or postgraduate specialization in HR is preferred
* Proven experience in HR Business Partnering, HR Operations, or HR Management roles
* Strong understanding of organizational development, workforce planning, employee engagement, and performance management
* Experience supporting transformation initiatives within technology, digital services, consulting, or GCC environments
* Working knowledge of Indian Labour Laws, statutory compliance, and employee relations practices
* Experience managing performance cycles, rewards programs, and leadership development initiatives
* Strong stakeholder management and business partnering capabilities
* Analytical mindset with experience leveraging HR metrics and workforce insights for decision\-making
* Ability to manage organizational change and navigate evolving business priorities
* Strong communication, coaching, and relationship management skills
* High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and organizational discipline
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Future\-Ready Skills (Nice to Have)

description:
**COMPANY INTRODUCTION**

**Job Purpose:**

The role involves candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, hiring follow\-ups, recruitment tracking, and maintaining smooth communication with candidates, hiring managers, clients, and internal stakeholders.

The position requires close collaboration with business leaders, hiring managers, and clients to ensure efficient and high\-quality recruitment delivery.

**Minimum Education Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Commerce, or a related discipline.

**Preferred** 



* MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management or a certification in recruitment, HR operations, labour laws, HR analytics, or payroll administration.

**Relevant Experience** 



* 2\-4 years of experience in HR operations, recruitment coordination, talent acquisition, or HR generalist support.

**Skills:** 




**Functional** 



* Talent acquisition and candidate coordination
* Recruitment tracking and hiring process management
* Employee documentation and onboarding coordination
* Attendance, payroll input, and HR data management
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets
* Basic understanding of HR operations and compliance documentation



  





**Behavioral** 



* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination abilities
* Ownership\-driven approach with strong follow\-up skills
* Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation
* Ability to handle confidential information professionally
* Organised, process\-oriented, and disciplined working style
* Professional and people\-friendly approach while interacting with candidates and employees



  





**Additional Expectations** 



* Ability to manage multiple hiring requirements and coordination tasks efficiently
* Strong responsiveness, ownership, and follow\-up discipline
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and execution\-driven environment
* Proactive mindset with willingness to learn and grow within Talent Acquisition and Recruitment Operations
* Ability to maintain professionalism, accuracy, and timely communication under pressure

**Description**
 Join ShipTech Analytics (STA) as a Data Engineer to build the data and analytics backbone powering Amazon's global transportation network. You'll contribute to our vision of building an intelligent, autonomous, and scalable performance management and decision support system across Amazon Transportation.
   

  

 As a Data Engineer I, you'll work on building standardized data solutions that empower operations teams worldwide. You'll develop both near\-real\-time (NRT) streaming pipelines and batch processing pipelines that deliver critical insights for decision\-making. You'll also build data tools that enable self\-service analytics and automate operational tasks, while contributing to innovative AI\-powered solutions delivering automated insights across the transportation network.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and build scalable near\-real\-time (NRT) streaming and batch data pipelines supporting Amazon's global transportation network.
* Build data products and data tools that streamline the complete data lifecycle including data ingestion, processing, backfill, storage, vending, and operational support modules.
* Partner closely with stakeholders across operations and analytics teams to understand requirements, design solutions, and deliver datasets and data tools that enable faster, more informed decision\-making
* Own data quality and implement enhancements for datasets that enable operational excellence and improve customer experience
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to standardize analytics capabilities and build AI\-powered automation
* Leverage AWS cloud technologies to transform raw data into actionable metrics
* Drive continuous improvement through code reviews, design discussions, operational best practices, and security compliance


 A day in the life
   

  

 You work backwards from what stakeholders need, clarifying ambiguities and building data products and tools. Throughout the day, you're writing code for data pipelines and building tools that handle ingestion, processing, storage, and vending alongside software engineers.
   

  

 Some days you're in design discussions about data infrastructure, pipelines and tools.
   

  

 Beyond coding, you're documenting datasets, tools and runbooks, and participating in code reviews. When oncall, you monitor the pipeline health.
   

  

 What makes the role interesting is the variety \- you're partnering with stakeholders, TPMs, SDEs building scalable data pipelines and tools that directly affect how Amazon's transportation network operates.
   

  

**About The Team**
 ShipTech Analytics serves as the data and analytics backbone for Amazon's global transportation network. The team builds standardized data solutions that streamline analytics and enable faster decision\-making for operations teams worldwide. Team members collaborate with cross\-functional partners to deliver data products and tools.
   

  

 The team is modernizing systems, building near\-real\-time architectures, and building AI\-powered automation. Team members have opportunities to mentor others, prototype new ideas , and shape the future of the data analytics. The team values collaboration across geographies with members in multiple locations working together to serve global operations.

title: Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go\-to person for second\-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
   

  

 You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
   

  

 As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
   

  

 You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Proficiency in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco Nexus switches/routers/firewalls, and more familiarity with ticketing tools.
* At least one technical certification in the above\-mentioned technologies.
* Strong planning skills, with the ability to anticipate and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening and client\-centric communication.

 C • C\+\+ • Python • Embedded Linux • MQTT • OCPP • CAN Bus • RS485 • Ethernet • ARM • ESP32 • STM32 • Raspberry Pi

title: Data Scientist 1
description:
Responsible for analyzing strategic business objectives, utilizing statistical and mathematical programming techniques for machine learning and predictive analytics, developing and implementing algorithms and models, applying natural language processing, designing network simulation models, developing automated solutions, prototyping applications, managing projects, and communicating complex findings as a Data Scientist.
   

  

* Analyze strategic business objectives and leverage advanced analytical research to drive data\-driven decision\-making.
* Utilize statistical and mathematical programming techniques for machine learning, predictive analytics, and other advanced data modeling tasks.
* Develop and implement machine learning algorithms and predictive analytics models to extract insights and make future predictions.
* Apply natural language processing techniques to extract meaningful insights from unstructured textual data.
* Develop algorithms and methods for efficient information retrieval from large datasets.
* Design and optimize network simulation models to improve efficiency and performance.
* Develop automated solutions to streamline processes and increase operational efficiency.
* Prototype and develop applications to demonstrate the feasibility and functionality of data\-driven solutions.
* Manage data science projects from inception to completion, ensuring adherence to timelines and deliverables.
* Communicate complex analytical findings effectively through data visualization and storytelling techniques.


 Education: Master’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, MIS, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar discipline.
   

  

 Relevant work experience as a data scientist based on the following number of years:
   

  

 Standard I: Two (2\) years

* Fluency in English
* Strong foundation in statistics and machine learning
* Strong programming skills in Python
* Solid SQL skills for data analytics
* Ability to present and communicate findings to management stakeholders
* PowerPoint, Reporting and Dashboarding skills necessary
* Process automation and Problem\-solving skills considered a plus
* Proven ability to deliver end‑to‑end data projects
* Demonstrated business impact from prior work
* Portfolio or examples of applied, real‑world work

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. title: AI/Machine Learning Engineer
description:

You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams including data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to design, develop, and maintain robust machine learning models and workflows. Your work will involve transforming raw data into actionable insights, optimizing algorithms for performance, and integrating AI capabilities into dynamic applications to provide seamless user experiences and enhanced functionality.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Assist in building and maintaining ML and basic Generative AI pipelines (data preprocessing, training, evaluation, and inference).
* Support development of simple RAG\-based and NLP workflows under guidance.
* Work on text processing tasks such as data cleaning, parsing, chunking, and embeddings.
* Contribute to backend APIs (e.g., FastAPI) to expose ML/AI functionalities.
* Help integrate AI models into applications and support deployment activities.
* Write clean, modular, and testable Python code following best practices.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and cross\-functional teams to deliver features.
* Debug, test, and optimize models and pipelines for performance and reliability.
* Stay updated with basic advancements in AI/ML and Generative AI.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.

* Good programming skills in Python and strong problem\-solving ability.

title: AI Agent Developer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Sunkool Solution is an India\-based company, founded in 2006, specializing in high\-quality car\-protection products. The company focuses on window films, paint protection film (PPF), and nano\-ceramic coatings designed to enhance vehicle durability and comfort. Sunkool Solution combines practical innovation with reliable service to meet the needs of automotive customers and partners. The organization continues to grow its presence by offering trusted, long\-lasting solutions for vehicles across diverse conditions. Candidates joining the team can expect to work in a product\-oriented environment with a strong focus on quality and technical excellence.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site AI Agent Developer role based in Nagpur. The AI Agent Developer will design, build, and maintain AI agents to support internal operations, customer interactions, and process automation. Daily responsibilities include gathering requirements from stakeholders, translating them into technical specifications, and implementing AI\-driven workflows. The role involves integrating AI agents with existing tools and data sources, testing performance, and iterating on models and prompts for accuracy, reliability, and safety. The AI Agent Developer will also document solutions, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and provide technical support and training to teammates who use these AI systems.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in software development, including experience with one or more programming languages commonly used for AI (such as Python or JavaScript), version control, and debugging.
* Knowledge of AI/ML concepts, including large language models, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and integrating AI APIs into applications.
* Experience designing and building workflow automations or chat\-based agents, including requirements gathering, solution design, and user\-centric testing.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms or deployment environments, APIs, and basic data structures to connect AI agents with internal tools and data sources.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex workflows into modular, testable components.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including documenting technical designs and explaining AI behavior to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work on\-site in Nagpur, collaborate effectively in a team setting, and manage time and priorities in a full\-time environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; previous work with automotive, manufacturing, or operations\-focused solutions is a plus.

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




 At Cobot Cognition, we're building intelligent robotic systems that enable robots to perceive, understand, and operate effectively in real\-world environments.
 



  





 Our mission is to bridge the gap between cutting\-edge AI research and practical robotic deployment, helping organisations automate complex physical workflows while keeping humans at the centre of the process. By combining robotics, computer vision, machine learning, and intuitive user experiences, we're creating the next generation of collaborative robotic solutions.
 



  





 We're a multidisciplinary team of roboticists, AI engineers, and product builders working on some of the most exciting challenges in embodied intelligence and human\-robot collaboration.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a Robotics Applications Engineer to serve as the bridge between our technology and real\-world customer challenges.
 



  





 In this role, you'll work directly with robotic systems, customer use cases, and our engineering team to design, build, and demonstrate end\-to\-end robotic solutions. You'll take customer problems and turn them into compelling demonstrations and pilot deployments that showcase the capabilities of Cobot Cognition's technology.
 



  





 This is a highly hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working across hardware, software, AI, and customer\-facing activities. You'll help validate new applications, integrate robotic platforms, and play a key role in bringing intelligent robotics into production environments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 \* Design and build end\-to\-end robotic demonstrations and proof\-of\-concepts based on customer requirements
 



 \* Integrate robotic hardware, sensors, and perception systems with Cobot Cognition's software stack
 



 \* Develop and maintain demo environments, test scenarios, and application workflows
 



 \* Deploy, commission, and troubleshoot robotic systems in laboratory and customer environments
 



 \* Work closely with engineering teams to identify product gaps, integration challenges, and opportunities for improvement
 



 \* Evaluate new robotic platforms, sensors, and tooling to expand the range of supported applications
 



 \* Create technical documentation, videos, and supporting materials for customer demonstrations and pilot projects
 



 \* Support pre\-sales activities through technical discussions, workshops, and live demonstrations
 



 \* Collect feedback from customers and translate real\-world requirements into actionable engineering insights
 



 \* Stay current with developments in robotics, AI, perception, and autonomous systems
 



  





**Requirements** 




 \* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience working with robotic systems in industrial, research, or commercial environments
 



 \* Experience integrating and deploying robots, sensors, cameras, or automation systems
 



 \* Strong programming skills in Python
 



 \* Experience with ROS/ROS2 and robotic software development workflows
 



 \* Practical understanding of robot kinematics, motion planning, perception, or manipulation
 



 \* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across hardware and software systems
 



 \* Experience working with computer vision, sensor fusion, or AI\-enabled robotic systems
 



 \* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences
 



 \* Self\-motivated and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced startup environment
 



 \* Willingness to work hands\-on with physical robotic hardware and customer deployments
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 \* Experience with industrial robots, collaborative robots, or autonomous mobile robots
 



 \* Familiarity with computer vision frameworks such as OpenCV, DepthAI, or modern vision foundation models
 



 \* Experience with machine learning for robotics, including imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or embodied AI
 



 \* Experience deploying robotic systems in manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, or field robotics environments
 



 \* Familiarity with simulation tools such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or MuJoCo
 



 \* Experience working directly with customers, pilots, or field deployments
 



 \* Experience with cloud infrastructure, robotics telemetry, or fleet management systems

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About Delivery Hero India:** 




  





 Delivery Hero India is part of Delivery Hero Group, the world’s leading local delivery platform. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide, powered by tech but driven by people. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 We are looking for a data\-driven, curious, and deeply empathetic
 **Associate Product Manager II \- Consumer** 
 to join our team in India. In this role, you will play a key part in executing our organic growth strategy. This isn't just about moving metrics\-it requires a genuine
 **love for consumers** 
 and a
 **keen eye for UI/UX** 
 . Working closely with senior product leaders, you will leverage data, technical understanding, and competitive benchmarks to run experiments that optimize our product experience. You should be someone who can gracefully
 **balance various user personas while ensuring we build features designed to scale** 
 .
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* **Execute Growth Initiatives:** 
 Assist in evaluating business processes and user journeys to identify friction points and implement effective product solutions.
* **User Persona \& Scale Management:** 
 Design and optimize growth loops that cater to diverse user personas without compromising system scalability or adding unnecessary complexity.
* **Data \& User Analysis:** 
 Analyze user behavior using quantitative (analytics tools) and qualitative (user feedback) insights to uncover growth barriers.
* **Run Experiments:** 
 Help design, set up, and execute A/B tests, feature rollouts, and upsell/cross\-sell tactics to move key product metrics.
* **Trend Tracking \& Benchmarking:** 
 Continuously monitor industry trends, competitor growth tactics, and market benchmarks to inject fresh, modern practices into our roadmap.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner daily with marketing, engineering, UI/UX design, and customer success teams to ensure smooth execution of growth features.
* **Documentation:** 
 Own the creation and maintenance of clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and feature documentation.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 2\-3 years of experience in product management, business analysis, or growth\-focused roles, preferably within B2C sectors (Food \& Beverage, e\-commerce, travel, CRM, or Loyalty).
* **Consumer Obsession \& Scale Mindset:** 
 A profound empathy and love for consumers, with a demonstrated ability to think through different user personas and map out scalable product experiences.
* **Design \& Trend Sensibility:** 
 A sharp eye for clean UI/UX design principles, an intuitive understanding of great user flows, and an active interest in staying updated on global product trends.
* **Education:** 
 A Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering or a technical field with a strong academic record.
* **Technical \& Product Skills:** 
 Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, requirement gathering, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* **AI\-Assisted Development \& MVP Building:** 
 A true practitioner of
 **"vibe coding"** 
 and modern AI\-assisted creation. Highly efficient in leveraging Generative AI tools and agentic workflows (e.g., Claude Agents/Projects, Custom GPTs) to accelerate workflows like PRD drafting and research and capable of using tools and low\-code platforms (e.g., Cursor, v0, Bolt.new, Bubble) to
 **independently build, test, and launch functional MVPs** 
 for rapid experimentation.
* **Core PM Stack \& Analytics:** 
 Deeply familiar with standard industry tools required for daily product management execution, including collaboration and wireframing tools (
 **Jira, Confluence, Miro, Figma** 
 ) as well as data and product analytics platforms (
 **Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Google Analytics** 
 ).
* **Soft Skills:** 
 Exceptional communication, attention to detail, a collaborative spirit, and an eagerness to acquire new technologies and tackle complex growth challenges.



  





**Why Join Delivery Hero India?** 




  





 At Delivery Hero India, we believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring \- therefore, we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you. Just be yourself, and we can’t wait to see what value you bring to the role. We're as interested in your character as we are in your talent.
